data.one_liner: A build system for Dart code generation and modular compilation.
data.what_it_does: A build system that executes code generators (builders) in Dart and Flutter projects. It supports running single builds or continuous watch modes to automatically update generated files when sources change.
use_when: You are using packages that require code generation like json_serializable or freezed
You need to automate running builders in watch mode during development
avoid_when: Your project does not use any code-generating libraries
You want a zero-config setup without build tools
strengths: Integrates seamlessly with popular serialization and utility packages
Supports incremental builds and continuous watch mode
weaknesses: Requires running commands via terminal or IDE to update generated files
Can slow down build times on large projects
data.setup_notes: Add as a dev_dependency in pubspec.yaml and execute via dart run build_runner build or watch.
